general.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Lives Up To Hype
general.summary: The highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI received close to perfect scores across the board on Wednesday morning, making it the best-reviewed game of all time, according to major review-aggregation websites. Players have been waiting more than a decade for the new open-world action title from Rockstar Games, which comes out on Nov. 19. Bloomberg News Video Game Industry Reporter Jason Schreier was able to experience the highly-anticipated game ahead of its release

general.title: Bloomberg New Economy Forum Opening Welcome Remarks
general.summary: John Micklethwait, Editor-in-Chief, Bloomberg, delivers welcome remarks at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Anthropic Is Said to Price IPO at $83 Per Share
general.summary: Anthropic PBC has priced its IPO at $83 per share, according to people familiar with the matter. The size of the offering has increased, the people said, asking not to be identified as the information isn’t public. The IPO is expected to price Wednesday and trade Thursday on the Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. Ed Ludlow, Bloomberg Tech host, reports ahead of trading tomorrow. (Source: Bloomberg)
